name: v2.0.0
body:
For macOS users, you can now use homebrew to install curl-impersonate:

```sh
brew install lexiforest/tap/curl-impersonate
```

## Breaking Changes

* Building system was changed to CMake.
* curl version was updated to 8.21.0.

## What's Changed
* feat: add Colab playground for build and testing by @alpgul in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/256
* Fix download regression in http2 by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/259
* Follow Chrome's behavior on QUIC grease value by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/260
* Migrate to cmake based building process by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/218
* Add support for FreeBSD by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/266
* WS: Hardware-accelerated WebSocket masking via SIMD by @Sh3llcod3 in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/251
* Add a cmake X_URL_HASH for each project download by @mhio in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/273
* build: build openbsd by @anoduck in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/272
* Add missing options for http3 and websockets only behavior by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/274
* Bump boringssl version to chrome 150 by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/275
* Merge curl 8.21.0 by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/276

name: v1.5.0
body:
Full http3 support is finally here: **udp proxy** and **http3 fingerprints** are now official!

We added chrome145 and firefox147 with builtin http3 fingerprints support. This release also brings a few other significant enhancements that have been exploited in the wild.

## What's Changed
* Add option for setting form boundary by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/213
* Turn ECH to true correctly, and align with browser behavior by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/214
* Do not override header when using CURL_IMPERSONATE by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/215
* Add support for http3 fingerprints by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/217
* Allow user to change the order of Host header in http 1.1


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/compare/v1.4.4...v1.5.0

name: v1.0.0
body:
This major release contains **breaking changes** and new features.

## Breaking changes

* Changed the binary name from (lib)curl-impersonate-chrome to (lib)curl-impersonate.
* Changed the directory layout of the project.
* Changed safari target name convention from `safari18_4_ios` to `safari184_ios`.

## New features

http/3 support, only available on Linux and macOS, **Windows binaries were built without http/3**.

```sh
curl_chrome136 -IL --http3-only https://cloudflare-quic.com
```

We failed to build ngtcp2 on Windows, if you are familiar with the Windows or mingw toolchain, please help.

## Details
* Upgrade curl to 8.13.0 by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/114
* Add `tor145`, `safari184`, `safari184_ios`, `chrome136` impersonation target.
* Stop enabling accept_encoding for all by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/117
* Add http/3 support by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/121
* Use binary search to find impersonate target by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/123
* Add Tor 14.5 by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/124
* Link with pthread by @MrLolthe1st in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/126
* Fix Windows MSVC build by @lexiforest in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/131
* Silence GCC15 deprecation warning raising errors in BoringSSL build by @zer0def in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/132

## New Contributors
* @MrLolthe1st made their first contribution in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/126
* @zer0def made their first contribution in https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/pull/132

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lexiforest/curl-impersonate/compare/v0.9.5...v1.0.0
